component.name: DSH Desktop
component.summary: Local-first AI agent harness with a desktop UI

description.p: DSH Desktop is a local-first AI agent platform: a Cordis plugin graph, persistent sessions, and a desktop UI that talks to a Node webserver child process.
Features: profile-based command line, browser and desktop UI surfaces, filesystem and shell tools, MCP client, multi-turn conversation with tool calls, durable session log in SQLite.
Initial desktop release: macOS DMG, Windows NSIS, Linux Flatpak.
